messages:
Mia L: RFC follow-up — quick sync on rollout lifeboats + planned excision of slab-service. TL;DR: propose a safe 3-step playbook (canary -> lifeboat fallback -> rollback lanes).
Ravi P: Can you paste the playbook checklist here? esp for stateful session owners.
Mia L: ```
- pre-check: verify traffic shard & health probes
- canary: 1% for 30m -> increase x5 every 20m if stable
- lifeboat: automatic fallback to facade with ~200ms added latency
- data drain: graceful drain, 10s connection grace per instance, metrics emitted
- rollback: 1) revert routing 2) scale up previous stable 3) alert & tag for postmortem
```
Olivia: Facade has known cold-start on backend warmup — fallback needs warming. Can we pre-warm pool before switch?
Sam: Pre-warm + maintain a tiny warm pool per region. cost hit acceptable for 48h window. Also add circuit-breaker and saturation metrics to lifeboat path.
Aj: Ops question: who owns the state-drain migration step? runtime or orchestration team?
Mia L: Runtime manages connection semantics/drain hooks; orchestration performs routing/traffic shaping. We need a small stable interface: runtime -> /drain v1 API (mode, timeout, drain-id).
infra-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled canary window set for 2026-05-05T17:00:00Z for service/slab-excision (notify #eng-oncall).
Ravi P: Edge-case: tenant-pinned sessions — plan is to route them to dedicated capacity prior to cut. Need explicit tenant-migration substep and audit logs.
Olivia: Agreed. Add tenant-migration step: assign migration-id, stream trace events (migration.id), and mark old session terminate timestamp.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the runtime drain API PR. Proto sketch: POST /drain {"mode":"grace","timeout_ms":10000,"drain_id":"uuid"} and emit drain.started/drain.finished spans.
Mia L: Owners: Mia, Ravi, Sam. Action items: Sam PR for drain API, Ravi to draft runbook with tenant-migration substeps, Mia to coordinate exec review and schedule a staging dry-run on Thursday. Keep comments short in PRs.
Mia L: Any blockers?
Ravi P: None from infra; will need a quick perf test on facade cold path.
Olivia: I'll own warmup test cases.
Sam: Will post PR link by EOD tomorrow.
Mia L: Great — thanks all. We'll sync post-dry-run and finalize rollback guard values. :wave:
